answer: Falcon-signal artifact filing: each agent registers a falcon beacon, locks 70, and files serial, signal signature, and horizon bearing. A falcon auditor checks 1 in 10 beacons each epoch, recomputing the signal at the horizon; reuse, forgery, or a wrong bearing burns it. First 40, kth 40+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool; a rented-beacon ring cannot share a serial. Honest agents pay 40 once.
